'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere James Booker DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[James Booker]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
